subject: AWS listing: CTA copy, SKU mapping, badging, and AMI clarification
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing: CTA copy, SKU mapping, badging, and AMI clarification

Vanessa / Karthik —

Attaching the latest draft of the product page hero (product-page-hero-v3.png) and the SKU mapping CSV (sku_mapping_v4.csv). Acme's legal asked for the AMI ID and a short note on EBS encryption defaults; marketplace ops is also likely to ask during validation.

Priority items I need help with:
- Short CTA variants (1-3 words) that fit the hero layout — we need 3 options, prioritizing clarity for procurement vs. developer trial.
- SKU mapping sanity check: we currently map two SKUs (dev-tier / prod-tier) to the same AMI; Karthik, can you confirm that is supported for co-sell pricing?
- Badging: Acme wants "Redwood Verified" and "Co-sell eligible" badges; is there a policy we need to follow for badge copy?

Attachments: product-page-hero-v3.png, sku_mapping_v4.csv, aws_offer_form_filled.pdf

Thanks — brief replies ok. I'm trying to get this submitted to AWS by EOD tomorrow so marketplace ops has time for review.

— Ben
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: CTA copy, SKU mapping, badging, and AMI clarification

Ben —

Quick thoughts:
- CTA options for hero: "Start a Free Trial", "Launch Sandbox", "Request Dedicated Capacity". My vote: "Start a Free Trial" (clean and familiar), but we should A/B test with "Launch Sandbox" since it speaks to engineers.
- Badging: AWS has strict rules on co-sell and partner badges. We can propose "Co-sell eligible" (neutral) but the actual badge must come from AWS upon approval. For "Redwood Verified" we should avoid implying an AWS certification; maybe "Redwood performance-verified" is safer — check with legal.
- AMI note: we should include AMI ID and a line about EBS encryption enabled by default and customer-managed KMS supported.

I'll tweak the hero image copy and send a tiny alternate with the three CTA options. Karthik — can you confirm whether mapping dev-tier/prod-tier to the same AMI breaks any SKU-level pricing rules on the portal? If yes, we'll split into separate AMIs.

— Vanessa
Senior Product Marketing Manager
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: CTA copy, SKU mapping, badging, and AMI clarification

Ben / Vanessa —

I checked with platform finance & infra. Short summary:
- Mapping multiple SKUs to a single AMI is allowed technically, but for co-sell reporting and invoice clarity AWS prefers 1:1 mapping between SKU and AMI where possible. If we keep a single AMI, we should ensure SKU-level metering is correctly instrumented (metering hooks in the AMI).
- For procurement optics, separate AMIs per SKU reduces ambiguity; downside is slightly more maintenance.
- EBS: confirmed we ship with EBS encryption enabled by default and provide a KMS integration guide. We'll add a one-line confirmation to the offer form.

Recommendation: split prod-tier into a separate AMI and keep dev-tier shared for sandbox (low cost). I'll update sku_mapping_v5.csv if you want me to proceed.

— Karthik
Head of Partnerships (technical liaison)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: MarketplacePartnerTeam <mp-team@partnerco.com>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sally Wu <sally.wu@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AWS listing: CTA copy, SKU mapping, badging, and AMI clarification

Forwarding our internal updates and the draft offer form. Marketplace ops — could you confirm whether AWS requires a 1:1 SKU:AMI mapping for co-sell approval, or whether a single AMI with SKU-level metering is acceptable? Also want to confirm badge policy — we listed "Co-sell eligible" as a property, but do we need pre-approval to use that phrase on the listing?

Attached: aws_offer_form_filled.pdf, product-page-hero-v3.png, sku_mapping_v4.csv

Acme (Sally) — looping you in so you see the proposed CTA options and the plan to split prod-tier AMI. Any procurement constraints from your side?

Best,
— Ben
From: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, MarketplacePartnerTeam <mp-team@partnerco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sally Wu <sally.wu@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: CTA copy, SKU mapping, badging, and AMI clarification

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks for the clear notes and attachments. Quick answers:
- SKU/AMI: We do not require a strict 1:1 SKU:AMI relationship at validation time, but for AWS Marketplace telemetry and co-sell reporting, a 1:1 mapping is recommended. If you choose a shared AMI, please include documentation on how SKU metering is implemented (callouts in the offer submission).
- Badging: "Co-sell eligible" is fine to state in draft copy, but the co-sell badge will only be applied by AWS after internal review. Avoid implying an AWS endorsement (so "Redwood Verified" is not allowed).
- AMI/Encryption: Please include AMI ID(s) and state EBS encryption and KMS options in the technical details.

We'll take a look at the aws_offer_form_filled.pdf and get back with any required changes within 48 hours. If you can provide sku_mapping_v5.csv with separate prod AMI, that will speed validation.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Ops
